messages.message_marked_need_response_success: The message marked as solution needed successfully.
messages.message_marked_need_response_fail: The message was not marked as solution needed.
messages.message_marked_has_response_success: The message marked as solution received successfully.
messages.message_marked_has_response_fail: The message was not marked as solution received.
messages.message_marked_read_success: The message marked as read successfully.
messages.message_marked_read_fail: The message was not marked as read.

mark_need_response.description: Mark a message as awaiting a reply: it appears in the list of messages needing a reaction for the conversation members.

mark_has_response.description: Remove the awaiting-a-reply mark from a message.

mark_read_message.description: Mark a message as read by the current user and return the updated unread counters.

mark_read.description: Mark a message as read by the current user, without recalculating the counters in the response.

mark_important.description: Toggle the important mark on an object for the current user: if it was set, it is removed, otherwise it is added.

params.obj_type: Object type: message, task, application and other site object types
